BiblicalUsage: Malkiel was a son of Beriah, of the tribe of Asher, named in Genesis 46:17 among those who went down into Egypt, and in 1 Chronicles 7:31, where he is called the father of Birzavith, while Numbers 26:45 names the family of the Malchielites after him. He went down into Egypt with Jacob's household, and his family is counted again in the wilderness census.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Malkiel's three verses trace one family's whole story: into Egypt, through the wilderness, and into the census of the new generation.
